Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their losing streak to a fourth consecutive session due to heavy foreign institutional investor selling, rising bond yields, and high crude prices. This market selloff erased Rs 5 lakh crore in investor wealth, though analysts recommend that long-term investors gradually accumulate stocks.

Markets.title: Valuations of IT stocks already capture most of AI disruption risk: Chintan Haria
Markets.summary: The Nifty IT index fell 25% in 2026, which may have priced in most artificial intelligence disruption risks. Chintan Haria of ICICI Prudential AMC believes selective opportunities remain in areas like cloud migration, data engineering, legacy modernisation, and AI integration.

Markets.title: RBI may hike repo rate by 25 bps as inflation and oil risks mount: Sunil Sanghai
Markets.summary: Sunil Sanghai predicts the RBI may increase the repo rate by 25 basis points in October to combat inflation and support the rupee. India's strong foreign reserves and manageable current account deficit will act as crucial economic buffers.

Markets.title: IT Q2 Preview: Muted growth, steady margins likely; deal conversion, AI deflation in focus
Markets.summary: India's top IT firms are expected to report modest revenue growth and stable margins for the second quarter due to constrained discretionary spending. Ongoing geopolitical issues and the impact of AI advancements on traditional services are also expected to prolong client decision-making cycles.

Markets.title: IPO bonanza: 29 companies to list this week; GMPs signal returns of up to 59%
Markets.summary: Twenty-nine companies are scheduled to debut on the stock market this week following a heavy fundraising period. Grey market premiums indicate potential returns of up to 59% for some firms, while others anticipate flat debuts.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Date, venue, speakers, agenda and registration
Markets.summary: The ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0 will take place on October 8 at the ITC Maratha in Mumbai. Investment experts will gather to discuss wealth creation strategies, alternative assets, and family office frameworks.

Geo-Political.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian drone struck the Pivnichyi Bridge in Kyiv, creating a large fireball as vehicles crossed the structure. The attack occurred during a surprise visit to the Ukrainian capital by the German chancellor.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
Geo-Political.summary: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is reporting from near Kyiv's Northern Bridge. The bridge has been struck by Russian attacks for the second consecutive day.

Geo-Political.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
Geo-Political.summary: Yemen's government declared an all-out war to reclaim territory from Houthi rebels. This announcement follows a series of mutual airstrikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

Geo-Political.title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
Geo-Political.summary: Pro-government forces have taken control of Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray region. This follows the withdrawal of rebel forces from the city, according to local residents.

Geo-Political.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike's lawyer stated that her prognosis remains unclear following a failed execution attempt. Doctors are currently working to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

Geo-Political.title: US Marine arrested over murder of woman in Okinawa, Japan
Geo-Political.summary: A U.S. Marine was arrested in Okinawa, Japan, for the murder of a local woman. The Japanese government lodged a formal protest with the United States and demanded immediate military action.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author tested AI-driven visibility and found that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI Optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create various types of digital media. In addition to content creation, the platform offers tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: The oil shock hasn’t stopped the factory boom. It may be changing what factories make | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: Despite rising energy costs and factory selling prices, manufacturers continue to expand their operations. High oil prices may be shifting the types of products these factories are making.

Data & Insights.title: RBI likely to raise repo rate in October 2026 as West Asia crisis fuels inflation risks
Data & Insights.summary: Experts expect the Reserve Bank of India to raise the repo rate by 0.25 percentage points during its October 2026 policy meeting. This anticipated rate hike is driven by escalating inflation risks stemming from the ongoing West Asia crisis.

Data & Insights.title: GST arrest powers may be removed? Council to discuss decriminalisation on Wednesday; law change likely in Winter Session
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council will discuss removing arrest powers under the indirect tax regime on Wednesday following concerns over their use against businesses. Any resulting law changes to limit GST enforcement are expected during the upcoming Winter Session.

Data & Insights.title: Easy money era is ending, interest rates to stay high: French economist Landau
Data & Insights.summary: Economist Jean-Pierre Landau warns that the era of easy money is ending because falling savings, rising investments, and heavy public debt will keep real interest rates high. This structural shift means borrowing costs are likely to remain elevated for the foreseeable future.

Data & Insights.title: India’s food market: $600 bn estimate; 7% CAGR — from primary producer to high-value global processing powerhouse
Data & Insights.summary: India's food market is valued at $600 billion with a 7% CAGR as the country transitions into a high-value global processing powerhouse. Experts state this growth, supported by the India–EU Free Trade Agreement, aims to double agricultural exports beyond the current $53 billion benchmark through value addition and market access.

Data & Insights.title: FM Sitharaman calls for open, predictable global economic ties amid rising uncertainty
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman urged for open and predictable global economic relationships to counter rising geopolitical tensions and trade barriers. She also called for increased private investment within India to strengthen the domestic economy.

India.title: Single-Use Plastic Bottles Banned At Delhi's Sports Complexes
India.summary: Single-use plastic bottles have been banned at all Delhi sports complexes by the Delhi Development Authority. Water dispensers and separate waste bins have also been installed as part of a month-long cleanliness drive.

India.title: 'LoRa' A New Security Challenge In Kashmir: Terrorists Using Advanced Tech
India.summary: Security agencies in Kashmir discovered that Pakistani terrorists are using advanced off-grid LoRa handsets. This technology shift presents a new security challenge for authorities in the region.

India.title: In Assam's Dhemaji, Grazing Land Being Developed As Village Forest
India.summary: A proposed village forest named Maguwahola is being developed on grazing land in Assam's Dhemaji district. This project is a collaborative effort between the local district administration and the Forest Department.

India.title: Human Rights Body Action Over Minors' Participation At Mumbai CJP Protest
India.summary: A human rights body has issued notices regarding the participation of minors in a Mumbai protest. The commission instructed police, government departments, and X Corp. to submit action taken reports within a week.

India.title: Adani Group, Kachchh University Launch Green Energy Centre Of Excellence
India.summary: Gujarat Governor Acharya Devvrat inaugurated the Adani Group and Kachchh University's new Green Energy Centre of Excellence. The facility aims to train over 10,000 students annually in renewable energy technologies and industrial automation.

India.title: Cross-Border Arms Network Busted In Punjab, AK-47, Grenades Seized
India.summary: Punjab Police arrested Navjot Singh from Tarn Taran district after intercepting him on a motorcycle. Authorities seized AK-47 rifles and grenades from the accused as part of a busted cross-border arms network.

General.title: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
General.summary: Green Party members at the Brighton conference voted to approve a motion stating that "Zionism is racism." This vote has created divisions among top figures within the party.

General.title: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
General.summary: Kemi Badenoch has described herself as a classic old-school Conservative. The new Tory leader is using this stance to align her political principles with those of Margaret Thatcher.

General.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
General.summary: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv's Northern Bridge following a Russian strike. The bridge has been hit for the second consecutive day.

General.title: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
General.summary: The British Museum is implementing new measures to reduce wait times for viewing the Bayeux Tapestry. These changes include extended opening hours, an audio guide, and extra seating for visitors.

General.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
General.summary: Yemen's government has declared an all-out war to reclaim territory currently controlled by Houthi rebels. This announcement coincides with ongoing military strikes exchanged between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.
